newsitem.title: USA: Yields fall on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices fell this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday, Oct 31, was 5.70 percent, down five basis points from last Thursday.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.60 percent, down four basis points from last Thursday.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 5.94 percent, down seven basis points from last Thursday.
